about_the_game:
'Save the Earth, or Not(STEON)' is a top-down shooter roguelite set in the vastness of space. Your mission is to defeat powerful, pattern-based bosses, collect 'Special Stones', and save the dying Earth.

Key Features

  • 🔴 Color Stone Weapon System: The six colored 'Color Stones', dropped by glowing purple enemies, instantly become your weapons. Combine different colors or collect just one to create powerful synergies.

  • 😺 Trade with Cat Merchants: Even after you're fully armed, 'Color Stones' aren't useless. Use them as currency to buy weapon upgrades or special stats from wandering cat merchants in space.

  • 🚀 Diverse Skills: Use 'Skill Fuel', dropped by gray enemies, to turn the battle in your favor. A variety of skills are at your disposal, including an emergency dodge to escape dangerous situations, a shockwave to blast enemies away, and a focused attack for a burst of firepower.

  • 🔧 Permanent Ship Upgrades: Game over isn't the end. Permanently upgrade your ship at the 'Upgrade Center' on the title screen to make your next run easier.

This game offers a single-player experience

short_description: A top-down shooter roguelite in space. Defeat enemies to collect six 'Color Stones' and use them as weapons. Use leftovers to buy upgrades from cat merchants and unleash skills to escape crises. Even in death, permanently upgrade your ship to challenge powerful bosses and save the Earth.
